Richness and utilization are soft preferences. Selected mode and pace determine stay time. Every accepted route is rechecked against both budgets.
route.time_budget_scope: Provided start to final stop's departure; approach walking included; no return journey.
route.scoring_distance_basis: Insertion ranking: added route distance; final node score: previous leg distance.

composition_diagnostics.basis: primary roles only; visit modes never promote roles
